items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: His name was Joe Bradford, a friend of mine

ctx.x: His name was Joe Bradford, a friend of mine, so I wrote a term, he told me, yes, come on up, see, so he was married and he had two daughters, and one of the girls was born while I was staying with him, so he made it so pleasant and so nice for me, like, saying I didn't have to pay a whole lot of money, and then he gave me a time to get around and make connection, you see, so well, it took me about nine months before I could actually find Wake, you know, So I finally found Wake, well, I stayed with him until…
Who else worked for you in this trio you had there?
